12112.text: Every director of a company commits an offence and is liable on conviction to the penalties set out in section 373(4) if

12114.text: the company incurs a debt (the debt); and

12118.text: is insolvent at the time that it incurs the debt; or

12120.text: becomes insolvent by incurring the debt; or

12122.text: is insolvent at the time that it incurs debts that include the debt; or

12124.text: becomes insolvent by incurring debts that include the debt; and

12126.text: the director knows, at the time when the company incurs the debt, that the company is insolvent or will become insolvent

12128.text: the director’s failure to prevent the company incurring the debt is dishonest.

12130.text: In subsection (4), insolvent means that the company is unable to pay its debts.
